name: Maturity curves
summary: Maturity curves that stay flat and then rise steeply, with numbered stages, an active stage, an inflection and an optional branch: generic four- and five-stage models in full-width, split, nav and table forms, and the AI-native product delivery curve with its capabilities, two-axis, stage-detail, assessment and coaching-plan companions.

templates.name: Maturity curve, four stages
templates.purpose: A four-stage maturity curve across the full width: flat at first, then steeply rising, each stage with a short description.

slide.title: Four stages take the practice from ad hoc to optimized

body.text: Each stage builds on the last. Early stages take effort and show little; the climb steepens once practice is shared.

stages.label: Ad hoc
stages.text: Work depends on individuals and varies by team.

stages.label: Defined
stages.text: Standard methods are written down and taught.

stages.label: Managed
stages.text: Teams measure results and correct course.

stages.label: Optimized
stages.text: Data drives continuous, shared improvement.

templates.name: Maturity curve, five stages with current stage
templates.purpose: A five-stage curve with a filled marker for the stage the client occupies today, and a one-line reading of what that means.

slide.title: Northfield sits at stage two of five

body.text: Teams repeat the same steps, but each team has its own method. A shared standard is the next move.

stages.label: Initial

templates.name: AI-native maturity curve
templates.purpose: The five-stage AI-native product delivery curve: manual to self-improving, with the scope axis along the bottom.

stages.label: Manual
stages.text: People do the work end to end; knowledge stays fragmented.

stages.label: Individually AI-assisted
stages.text: AI helps with bounded tasks; workflows stay unchanged.

stages.label: Repeatable team practice
stages.text: Teams reuse shared workflows with clear owners and defined review.

stages.label: Integrated AI-native flow
stages.text: People and agents coordinate across the lifecycle with clear handoffs.

stages.label: Self-improving delivery system
stages.text: Telemetry feeds agents that refine shared skills, so delivery improves on its own.

slide.title: Three lessons shape the climb to AI-native delivery

stages.label: Manual
stages.text: People do the work end to end.

stages.label: AI-assisted
stages.text: AI helps with bounded tasks.

stages.label: Repeatable
stages.text: Teams reuse shared workflows.

stages.label: Integrated
stages.text: People and agents coordinate.

stages.label: Self-improving
stages.text: Telemetry refines shared skills.

body.p: Gains stall until teams share workflows, not just licenses.
Defined review lets agents take on more of the work safely.
Self-improvement needs delivery data agents can learn from.
